titulo: Heaven tried to cook him alive 🐒 Sun Wukong Part 4 #story #shorts
descripcion:
Heaven gives the Monkey King a job, and it is the lowest rank in the sky. He smashes the stables, calls himself Great Sage Equal to Heaven, eats the Peaches of Immortality, steals Laozi's golden pills and fights 100,000 soldiers and the three-eyed god Erlang. Then they throw him into the furnace.

> Part 5 (final): tomorrow. Follow so you don't miss it.
What would you have stolen first?

From Journey to the West (Xiyouji), Wu Cheng'en, 16th century, chapters 4 to 7.
